kinds.d: Cord or flat tape threaded through eyelets to fasten a shoe.
Removable inner sole added to a shoe for comfort or fit, not a medical orthotic.
Pad stuck inside a shoe's heel to stop the foot slipping out.
Waterproof covering worn over a shoe to keep it dry.
Cloth or leather covering for the instep and ankle, worn over a shoe.

notes: Restraint only. Five old kinds kept (k59-k63) at kind level with their old sources. Overshoe: dropped Tingley Work Rubber Overshoes 1300 (trade model); the maker-less buckle-front and Russian-style galoshes became types. Spat: cloth/leather types kept; maker-less 'Highland piper spats' became a type. Shoelace gained flat/round/waxed types. No extra makers added because no web research was done; old data has only 1-2 makers per kind. No brand entries.
